title: The Little Mermaid. Ariel.
lines: Deep, deep under the sea, where the water is blue and green, there is a beautiful palace of mother-of-pearl and coral.
King Triton lives there, the king of the sea.
He has a golden trident and a long white beard.
She has long, fiery red hair and she has no legs.
Instead of legs Ariel has a long, sparkly green fish tail!
With it she swims super fast through the water.
Ariel has a voice as lovely as a little bird.
The first is Flounder, a little yellow fish with blue stripes.
Flounder is a bit scared, but he always comes along.
King Triton has asked Sebastian to look after Ariel.
Ariel is very curious about the people above the water.
And in that cave she collects things from people.
Forks, clocks, spoons, a pipe and a mirror.
She doesn't know what all those things are.
She goes to ask Scuttle the seagull.
This, says Scuttle, holding up a fork, is a little comb!
You comb your hair with it!
And Ariel combs her hair with a fork.
Ariel really wants to live on land.
She wants to walk, and dance, and jump on legs.
One evening she swims up to the surface.
There she sees a boat with fireworks.
On the boat is a handsome prince.
The boat sinks, and Eric falls into the sea.
She pulls him to the beach and sings him a song.
Eric hears her lovely voice, but he can't see her properly.
He breaks all her things in the cave.
Then two nasty eels come along.
Our mistress can help you, they whisper.
Their mistress is the sea witch Ursula.
Ursula is half human, half octopus, with eight long purple arms.
She lives in a dark cave.
I can give you legs, dear, says Ursula.
But in return I want something from you.
But she wants legs so badly.
And her voice flies out of her mouth like a golden light, into a shell around Ursula's neck.
Suddenly Ariel's tail turns into two legs!
She has to swim up quickly.
On the beach she tries to walk.
Prince Eric finds her on the beach.
He thinks she's sweet and funny.
They go out on the lake together in a little boat.
Sebastian sings a song, the frogs croak, and the birds whistle.
Eric almost gives her a kiss.
But Flotsam and Jetsam tip the boat over.
Then Ursula turns herself into a pretty girl, with Ariel's voice.
And Prince Eric thinks she is the girl from the beach!
But Scuttle the seagull, Flounder, Sebastian and all the animals help.
And the shell around her neck breaks.
The voice flies back to Ariel.
In the end Eric and Ariel defeat the sea witch.
Daddy Triton sees how much Ariel loves Eric.
He waves his trident, and Ariel gets legs forever.
They get married on a big ship.
And all the mermaids and fish and Sebastian the crab wave.
